tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "09F1B79F4C69101129CCE0B736F93EFC", "Press E to Combo Attack. Each Weapon type has its own Combos to master. Complete Combos to trigger powerful Finishers.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "BD5B0097401DD4F070DF8486F1AB574B", "Press 1 or Left Click to execute your first Class Skill. Each Class has a unique suite of Skills to learn and upgrade as you earn Experience and Level-Up.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "89957733436A626C1CD1C7BFC0737317", "Hold R to Guard and Block incoming Attacks. You must have a Shield or capable Melee Weapon equipped to Guard. Consumes Stamina.")
NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "9954D3D346B4CE8EA70C80AAF4D69CA8", "Press L-Ctrl to Dodge and Avoid incoming Attacks. Consumes Stamina.")
